Experience of handling the entire process of organizing a hackathon, marketing, driving registrations, ideating, creating prototypes, event planning, logistics, vendor management.

salary_details.details: Rs. 70,000/ - per month (Pro rata basis) for both TECH Team and Hackathon & Project Support posts.

content_sections.heading: TCIL Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the TCIL Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download TCIL Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: TCIL Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 2 for TECH Team and 1 for Hackathon & Project Support.

content_sections.heading: TCIL Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: TECH Team: B.E / B.Tech / M.Tech (Computer Science/ Computer Engineering/ Information Technology/ Electronics/ Electronics & Communication/ Electronics & Telecommunication) from a recognized University/ Institution with 3 years of experience in the subject matter. Strong understanding of 3GPP standards, 5G network architecture, RAN and core elements. Hackathon & Project Support: Bachelor in Science/ MCA/ B.E/ B.Tech (EE/ ECE/ CS) from a recognized University/ Institution with 3 years of experience in the subject matter. Experience of handling the entire process of organizing a hackathon, marketing, driving registrations, ideating, creating prototypes, event planning, logistics, vendor management.

content_sections.heading: TCIL Recruitment 2026 - Salary
content_sections.text: Rs. 70,000/ - per month (Pro rata basis) for both TECH Team and Hackathon & Project Support posts.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the TCIL Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 28-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TCIL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the TCIL Recruitment 2026 is 28 September 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in TCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the TECH Team / Hackathon & Project Support posts in the TCIL Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for these positions will receive a salary of Rs. 70,000/- per month on a pro rata basis.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for TCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application for TCIL Recruitment 2026 must be submitted through the online mode only. Offline applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: The required qualifications include B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech in relevant fields for TECH Team, and Bachelor in Science/MCA/B.E/B.Tech for Hackathon & Project Support.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for TCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for TCIL Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for TCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Skill Test, followed by an Interview, and finally Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is provided in the "Important Links" section of this article for your convenience.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions announced under TCIL Recruitment 2026 are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The jobs are located in Delhi, as indicated in the official notification for TCIL Recruitment 2026.
